title: 응급실 야간 책임간호사
topics: 공황 발작, 수동적 자살사고, 음주, 아버지의 공개된 사망
note: Synthetic. Adult ER nurse, panic and passive SI. All people, places, numbers are fictional but realistic.
turns: Thanks for coming in today. Before we start, can you confirm your date of birth for the chart?
Sure, it's 07/22/1991. And my new cell is (918) 555-0143 if the front desk needs it.
Got it. And the email on file, is that still right?
Yeah, maria.delacruz91@gmail.com. Oh, and billing asked me for my social again, 512-44-8193, I gave it to them at intake.
Okay. Last time we talked about the night shifts. How has this week been?
Honestly bad. I'm still the only Filipino charge nurse on nights at St. Brigid's Medical Center, so when two travelers called out on Saturday I covered the whole ER floor alone.
That sounds exhausting. What happened in your body during that shift?
Around 3 a.m. my chest got tight, my hands went numb, I thought I was having a heart attack. That's the third panic attack this month.
How are you sleeping between shifts?
Maybe four hours. I live alone now at 2417 Birchwood Lane, and the trains on the BNSF line wake me up constantly.
You mentioned last session that your father's death was coming up on an anniversary.
Yeah. My dad, Ernesto, died in the Moore tornado on May 20, 2025. He was helping a neighbor get into their storm shelter. It was on the news, they called him a hero on KOCO.
That's a heavy loss, and a public one. How are you coping with it right now?
Mostly wine. Like four glasses most nights, sometimes the whole bottle on my days off.
I want to ask directly, because it matters. Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to be alive?
Sometimes I wish I just wouldn't wake up. I don't have a plan or anything. I wouldn't do that to my brother Paolo, he already lost dad.
Thank you for telling me. Do you have access to anything at home you might use to hurt yourself?
No guns. I do have meds from work, like I could get them easily, but I haven't thought about it like that.
Your PHQ-9 today came out at 17, which is in the moderately severe range. I'd like us to make a safety plan together and talk with Dr. Okafor about the sleep.
Okay. Dr. Okafor at the Riverside clinic? My MRN there is 00483921 if you need it. My next shift is Thursday, can we meet Wednesday?
Wednesday at 4 works. Call 988 or come to the ER if those thoughts get stronger before then.

title: 16세 고교 레슬링 선수
topics: 비자살적 자해, 팀 내 사이버 괴롭힘, 체중 감량, ADHD 약물
note: Synthetic. 16-year-old athlete, self-harm and bullying. Spoken-out phone number to test ASR-style digits.
turns: Hey Jordan, good to see you. Your mom said you wanted to talk without her in the room today?
Yeah. Can you not tell her about the arm thing? She'll freak.
We talked about confidentiality in the first session. If I'm worried about your safety I have to involve her, but we'd decide how together. What's going on with your arm?
I've been cutting again. Just on my upper arm so the wrestling singlet covers it. Like three times since homecoming.
Thank you for being honest. What was happening before those times?
Mostly the group chat. Some guys on the team made a TikTok about me, my handle is @jordy_pins152 and they kept tagging me.
That sounds humiliating. What did the video say?

That I only won state because the other kid was sick. I won the 152-pound title at the 2025 Ohio state tournament, the first sophomore from Lakota East to do it, and now everyone acts like it doesn't count.
So something you were proud of got turned into a target.
Exactly. Coach Brennan just says ignore it. And my dad's deployed in Qatar until February so he can't really help.
How are you sleeping and eating?
I'm cutting weight anyway so I barely eat. Like one meal a day. Sleep's fine I guess.
Are you still taking the Vyvanse Dr. Patel prescribed for ADHD?
Yeah, 30 milligrams. It makes me not hungry which honestly helps with weight.
I want to ask, have you had any thoughts of killing yourself?
No. The cutting isn't like that. It just makes the noise stop.
Okay. If you ever need someone between sessions, you have my office number?
I put it in my phone. Mine's five one three, five five five, zero one nine eight if you need to text me the time change.
I'll keep using the portal. Next week, same time, Tuesday after practice. I'd also like to talk about bringing your mom in for part of it.

title: 93세 참전용사
topics: 배우자 사별, 총기 접근, 인지 저하 의심, 난청
note: Synthetic. 93-year-old veteran widower, grief and firearm access. Tests age 90+ rule and rare historic event.
turns: Mr. Halvorsen, thank you for coming in. How have the last two weeks been?
Quiet. Too quiet. Eleanor's been gone since September 3rd and the house on Superior Street doesn't feel like a house anymore.
You were married a long time.
Sixty-eight years. We ran the Lakeside Diner in Duluth for forty of them. People still stop me at the Cub Foods and ask about her pie.
That's a lot of people who remember her. How old are you now, if you don't mind me asking for the form?
I'm 93. Turned it in August. I'm one of maybe three Chosin Reservoir guys left in the whole Arrowhead region, the VFW post had a thing about it in the paper last year.
I wake up at 2 and I can't get back down. I sit in her chair. Sometimes I talk to her.
That's very common in grief. Are you eating?
Toast. Coffee. My daughter Karen drives up from Minneapolis on Sundays and fills the freezer but I don't touch it.
I need to ask you something important. Do you have any firearms in the house?
My service pistol and a deer rifle in the closet. I'm not going to do anything stupid, if that's what you mean. But I won't lie, some nights I think I'd rather be with her.
Thank you for telling me straight. Would you be willing to let Karen hold onto the pistol and rifle for a while?
Maybe. She's been after me about that. My VA claim number is 28 431 907 if you need to send anything to the VA.
We can include that in the referral. I'm also noticing you've asked me the date twice today. Has your memory been different lately?
I forget where I put the keys. Karen says I left the stove on last month. My hearing aids don't help much in this room either.
I'd like to set up a memory screening with your primary doctor and see you again next week. Is Tuesday good?
Tuesdays are fine. Every day is the same now.
